text.text_excerpt: i've seen the flagpole on insta a few times, so when one of my friends suggested it i was so excited to go. this is the perfect outdoor neighborhood spot to chat and snack and drink good coffee. i love that they sell fresh snoballs along with coffee and other snack and breakfast items. the staff as well as the owner was so incredibly nice and helpful. we got coffee and a few snoballs and sat outside on a sunday morning and it was so relaxing and pretty. the christmas decorations really made it so much more charming as well. since following on insta, it looks like they have live music quite a few days a week as well. the parking was easy and they had tons of it on the streets surrounding. ...

Day 7 of NOLA Coffee Crawl Creative use of space that brings together the community. They have an abbreviated menu and hours for now, but the current offerings are still worth the trip. Park your Blue Bike here and sit at one of the outdoor tables. Bring Fido and he'll get a tasty treat! I tried the iced latte, plain, and I'm glad I did- the coffee had a smooth, complex flavor that didn't need help. Also got a fruit turnover that I think was guava...flaky and delicious! Will come back for a snoball or smoothie sometime soon, and you should too!

This is an adorable outdoor snoball and coffee cafe in a quaint neighborhood. My mom and I stopped here for a quick iced latte and ended up staying a bit longer because the kind gentleman employee brought out a table and chairs for us. The menu is small but consist of the essentials, which is great for me because of my indecisiveness lol.
